The core judgment

The Jing-Zhang railway left Haidian two legacies: a spirit of self-reliant innovation worth commemorating, and a nearly ten-kilometre cut separating the east and west sides of the city. This proposal does not treat the belt as a spine to walk along, but as an urban wound to be mended.

One continuous heritage seam

running the full length as the public floor and walking spine

Twelve transverse stitches

the core public-space system, denser where crossing demand is real

Paired frontages across the seam

complementary rather than repeated, making crossing a daily necessity

An all-hours operating regime

one ground, different roles by day, night, weekend and event day — no new buildings

Three scope levels（三层范围）

Coordinated research area 43.6 km²

Where crossing demand originates; relational judgment only, no design geometry.

Overall design area 11.4 km²

Where the mending happens; a ribbon about 9.7 km by 1.3 km.

Key areas 368.4 ha

The three densest segments: build first, test, and reverse if needed.

Principal sources

  • Haidian Branch, Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources — pre-qualification announcement (2026-05-09): areas and written extents
  • Cleared taskbook extract for the global agent open call: positioning, five functions, six required tasks
  • Ministry of Natural Resources land- and sea-use classification guide: land-use coding
  • MOHURD urban design and regulatory detailed planning measures: depth requirements
  • Repository provisional_boundaries.geojson: used only for generation and display

Key assumptions and data gaps

  • No official precise boundary for this call is publicly available; all geometry is built on the provisional rough boundary and the whole chain must be recomputed once official redlines are released.
  • Stitch positions are inferred from announcement cues (Fifth Ring, Qinghe, Qinghua East Rd West Entrance, Wudaokou, Dazhongsi station) and are conceptual.
  • Floor area ratio and building height are statutory planning judgments; no approved control values exist in the public package, so no conclusion is given.
  • The proposal assumes real east-west crossing demand; this requires transport survey verification, and low measured use should trigger reversal rather than further investment.

This page is fully offline: no external scripts, fonts, map tiles or tracking. All spatial suggestions are conceptual references for professional teams to develop further.
